purpose: Bounded owned n12 OFF/2048 ready and post-three-text memory attribution, not a new latency benchmark or broad sweep.

requests.input: Mina did not buy 12 tickets; she bought 2.
requests.output: 미나가 티켓을 12장 산 게 아니라, 2장만 샀어요.

requests.input: この薬は一日2回です。3回ではありません。
requests.output: Take this medicine twice a day. Not three times.

ready.method: VirtualQueryEx64; QueryVirtualMemoryInformation MemoryRegionInfo once per AllocationBase; GetMappedFileNameW basename only; QueryWorkingSetEx batched Valid/Shared bits, no reads/touches/locks.
ready.limits: Non-atomic sequential no-touch observation bracketed by process/PDH samples, not an allocation call-stack trace. Valid/Shared are Windows page-query bits, not proof that device mappings are duplicate system DRAM. MEM_COMMIT RegionSize is not private commit; per-allocation CommitSize counted once. GPU driver charge may not appear in CPU VA CommitSize. Invalid/query-failed pages are not silently treated as measured resident zero.
